moves.about: concluding that the superfluous protection-verse teaches that protection joins with the food to make up the requisite measure

moves.cueHe: ואימא: יד להכניס ולא להוציא
moves.summary: floats a rival distribution: handle imports only, protection imports and exports, nothing about joining
moves.about: whether the verses could instead be distributed so that a handle only imports and protection only imports and exports, with no derivation for joining

moves.cueHe: יד להכניס ולא להוציא, לא מצית אמרת
moves.summary: knocks the suggestion down: importing entails exporting a fortiori
moves.about: whether a handle could import impurity yet not export it — it cannot, since exporting follows a fortiori from importing

moves.cueHe: ואימא: יד להוציא ולא להכניס
moves.summary: floats the mirror-image distribution: handle exports only
moves.about: whether the verses could instead be distributed so that a handle only exports and protection exports and imports, with no derivation for joining

moves.cueHe: יד יתירא כתיב
moves.summary: knocks it down by pointing to a third, superfluous handle derivation in the vessels passage
moves.about: answering that a third, superfluous handle-derivation exists in the vessels passage, so importing is covered

moves.cueHe: לכם״ – לכל שבצרכיכם, לרבות את הידות
moves.summary: expounds the vessels לכם as including handles, giving two handle derivations
moves.about: reading the vessels לכם as including handles

moves.cueHe: הי מינייהו מייתר?
moves.summary: asks which of the three handle verses is in fact the superfluous one
moves.about: which of the three handle-verses is actually superfluous, since each seems needed in its own context

moves.cueHe: לכתוב רחמנא בזרעים, וליתו הנך מינייהו
moves.summary: floats deriving vessels and carcass from seeds
moves.about: whether the vessels and carcass handle-rules could be derived from seeds — rejected because seeds have a broader susceptibility to impurity

moves.cueHe: מה לזרעים, שכן טומאתן מרובה
moves.summary: rejects it: seeds are more broadly susceptible to impurity

moves.cueHe: לכתוב רחמנא בתנור, וליתי הנך מיניה
moves.summary: floats deriving the others from the oven
moves.about: whether the other handle-rules could be derived from an oven — rejected because a vessel conveys impurity through its airspace

moves.cueHe: מה לתנור, שכן מטמא מאוירו
moves.summary: rejects it: an oven conveys impurity through its airspace

moves.cueHe: לכתוב רחמנא בנבלה, וליתי הנך מינה
moves.summary: floats deriving the others from the carcass
moves.about: whether the other handle-rules could be derived from a carcass — rejected because a carcass is stringent in three respects

moves.cueHe: מה לנבלה שכן מטמאה אדם
moves.summary: rejects it: a carcass is stringent in three separate respects

moves.cueHe: חדא מחדא לא אתיא, תיתי חדא מתרתי
moves.summary: answers that one case can still be derived from the other two together
moves.about: answering that although no one case yields another singly, one of the three can be derived from the other two, so a verse is still superfluous

moves.cueHe: הי תיתי?
moves.summary: asks which of the three is the derivable one
moves.about: which of the three could be derived from the other two

moves.cueHe: לא לכתוב רחמנא בזרעים, ותיתי מהנך
moves.summary: floats deriving seeds from carcass and vessels
moves.about: whether seeds could be derived from carcasses and vessels — rejected because those become impure without being rendered susceptible

moves.cueHe: מה להנך – שכן מטמאין שלא בהכשר
moves.summary: rejects it: those become impure without first being rendered susceptible

moves.cueHe: אמר רב הונא בריה דרב יהושע: פירות שלא הוכשרו
moves.summary: faults that refutation: unrendered produce is like an oven whose construction is unfinished
moves.about: whether requiring hekhsher really distinguishes seeds — produce not rendered susceptible is like an oven whose construction is unfinished

moves.cueHe: אלא פריך הכי: מה להנך, שכן מטמאין שלא בנגיעה
moves.summary: restates the refutation on a better ground: those become impure without contact
moves.about: restating the refutation of deriving seeds from the other two — those become impure without contact, whereas seeds require contact

moves.cueHe: לא לכתוב רחמנא בתנור, ותיתי מהנך
moves.summary: floats deriving the oven from food and carcass
moves.about: whether the oven case could be derived from food and carcass — rejected because both of those are food

moves.cueHe: מה להנך שכן אוכל
moves.summary: rejects it: both of those are food, an oven is not

moves.cueHe: לא לכתוב רחמנא בנבלה, ותיתי מהנך
moves.summary: floats deriving the carcass from food and vessels
moves.about: redirecting the superfluous carcass handle-verse to teach that a handle imports impurity generally

moves.cueHe: אין הכי נמי
moves.summary: accepts this one: the carcass handle rule is indeed derivable
moves.about: conceding that the carcass handle-rule can indeed be derived from the other two, so its verse is the superfluous one

moves.cueHe: אלא יד דנבלה למה לי?
moves.summary: asks why the carcass handle verse is written if it is derivable
moves.about: why the carcass passage states the handle rule at all once it is derivable

moves.cueHe: אם אינו ענין ליד נבלה, תנהו ענין ליד דעלמא
moves.summary: redirects the superfluous verse to teach that a handle imports impurity generally

moves.cueHe: יד להכניס, יד להוציא, שומר לצרף
moves.summary: sums up the derivation: handle imports, handle exports, protection joins

moves.cueHe: ואכתי, יד דנבלה אצטריך
moves.summary: objects that without the carcass verse דיו would have limited the derived rule, so it is not superfluous
moves.about: whether the carcass handle-verse is truly superfluous, given that without it דיו would limit the derived case to the stringency of its source

moves.cueHe: אלא, יד דנבלה מיצרך צריך, ושומר דנבלה הוא דלא צריך
moves.summary: shifts the superfluity from the carcass handle verse to the carcass protection verse
moves.about: answering that the carcass handle-verse is needed, and it is the carcass protection-verse that is superfluous

moves.cueHe: למאי הלכתא כתביה רחמנא?
moves.summary: asks what ruling the carcass protection verse could be teaching
moves.about: for what ruling the Torah wrote the carcass protection-verse, since joining is excluded and exporting follows a fortiori

moves.cueHe: אלא, אם אין ענין לשומר דנבלה, תנהו ענין ליד דנבלה
moves.summary: redirects it twice over, ending at a handle in general, and sums up again
moves.about: redirecting the superfluous carcass protection-verse first to the carcass handle and then to handles in general

moves.cueHe: ואימא: אם אינו ענין לשומר דנבלה, תנהו ענין לשומר דעלמא
moves.summary: floats redirecting the verse to protection in general instead of to a handle
moves.about: whether the superfluous carcass protection-verse should instead be redirected to protection in general rather than to a handle

moves.cueHe: אלא, מעיקרא כי כתיבא יד, אהכנסה כתיבא
moves.summary: answers that the original handle verse was written in the context of importing, so nothing need be redirected for it
moves.about: answering that importing was already written in the original handle-verse, so no redirection is needed for it

moves.cueHe: אלא שומר דנבלה, למה לי?
moves.summary: asks what the carcass protection verse is for on this account
moves.about: why the carcass protection-verse is written at all on this new account

moves.cueHe: לגופיה
moves.summary: answers that it teaches the law of protection for carcass impurity in its own right

moves.cueHe: ולמאי? אי לאצטרופי – אמרת לא מצטרף!
moves.summary: presses: neither joining nor importing and exporting is left for it to teach
moves.about: what לגופיה could teach, since joining is excluded and importing and exporting follow a fortiori

moves.cueHe: מילתא דאתיא בקל וחומר – טרח וכתב לה קרא
moves.summary: answers that Scripture sometimes writes explicitly what is derivable a fortiori
moves.about: answering that Scripture sometimes writes explicitly what could be inferred a fortiori

moves.cueHe: אי הכי, שומר דעלמא, אימא לך: להכניס
moves.summary: turns that principle back: then the general protection verse too might teach only importing
moves.about: whether, on that principle, the general protection-verse should also be read as teaching only importing rather than joining

moves.cueHe: היכא דאיכא למידרש, דרשינן
moves.summary: answers that where a verse can yield a novelty we expound it so
moves.about: answering that where a verse can be expounded to yield a novelty, we expound it so

moves.cueHe: רב חביבא אמר: שאני שומר דנבלה
moves.summary: answers differently: carcass protection behaves like a handle, so its verse is applied to handles
moves.about: why the superfluous carcass protection-verse is redirected to handles rather than to protection in general — carcass protection acts only as a handle does

moves.cueHe: מתקיף לה רב יהודה בר ישמעאל, הא דתנן
moves.summary: attacks the derivation of joining from על כל זרע זרוע, from the pomegranate protrusion that joins
moves.about: whether protection can be derived from על כל זרע זרוע, since a pomegranate protrusion joins although pomegranates are not sown with it

moves.cueHe: ואמאי? קרי כאן ״על כל זרע זרוע״, וליכא!
moves.summary: asks why the protrusion joins, since pomegranates are not sown with it
moves.about: why the protrusion joins, given that pomegranates are not taken out for sowing with it

moves.cueHe: ותו, הא דתנן: העור והרוטב והקיפה וכו׳
moves.summary: presses further from our own mishna's list, none of which is sown with the food
moves.about: from where our own mishna's list of hide, gravy and spices is derived, since none of them is sown with the food

moves.cueHe: אלא תלתא קראי כתיבי
moves.summary: answers by distributing three terms of the verse over protection of seeds, of trees, and of meat, eggs and fish
moves.about: answering that three separate terms in the verse cover protection of seeds, of trees, and of meat, eggs and fish

moves.cueHe: אמר רב חייא בר אשי, אמר רב: יש יד לטומאה, ואין יד להכשר
moves.summary: opens a new unit: Rav holds a handle counts for impurity but not for rendering food susceptible
moves.about: Rav's ruling that a handle counts for impurity but not for rendering food susceptible

moves.cueHe: ורבי יוחנן אמר: יש יד לטומאה ולהכשר
moves.summary: Rabbi Yoḥanan holds a handle counts for rendering susceptible as well
moves.about: whether a handle renders the attached food susceptible to impurity (hekhsher) as it does for impurity itself

moves.cueHe: במאי קמיפלגי?
moves.summary: asks what underlies the dispute
moves.about: what underlies the disagreement between Rav and Rabbi Yoḥanan about a handle and hekhsher

moves.cueHe: איבעית אימא קרא, מר סבר: מקרא נדרש לפניו, ולא לפני פניו
moves.summary: answers that they differ over how far back a verse may be expounded
moves.about: attributing to Rav the hermeneutic that a verse is expounded only with the phrase immediately preceding it

moves.cueHe: איבעית אימא סברא, מר סבר: הכשר תחלת טומאה הוא
moves.summary: answers alternatively that they differ over whether hekhsher is the first stage of impurity
moves.about: attributing to Rabbi Yoḥanan the reasoning that hekhsher is the first stage of the process of impurity

moves.cueHe: תניא כוותיה דרבי יוחנן
moves.summary: brings a baraita taught in accordance with Rabbi Yoḥanan
moves.about: a baraita equating handle for impurity with handle for hekhsher

moves.cueHe: אמר רב: אין יד לפחות מכזית
moves.summary: opens a further unit: Rav sets minimum measures for handle and for protection
moves.about: whether handle and protection have minimum measures — an olive-bulk for a handle and a bean-bulk for protection

moves.cueHe: ורבי יוחנן אמר: יש יד לפחות מכזית
moves.summary: Rabbi Yoḥanan holds there are no such minimum measures

moves.cueHe: מיתיבי: שתי עצמות, ועליהן שני חצאי זיתים
moves.summary: objects to both from the two-bones baraita
moves.about: whether a handle or protection attached to less than an olive-bulk of flesh conveys impurity

moves.cueHe: יהודה בן נקוסא אומר משום רבי יעקב
moves.summary: the baraita's second opinion, in Rabbi Yaakov's name: two bones cannot join to an olive-bulk
moves.about: the ruling that two bones cannot join to make up an olive-bulk

moves.cueHe: ורב האי במאי מוקים לה? אי ביד, קשיא רישא!
moves.summary: presses Rav: reading the baraita of a handle contradicts its first clause
moves.about: how Rav can establish the bones baraita, since reading it of a handle contradicts its first clause and reading it of protection contradicts its last

moves.cueHe: אי בשומר – קשיא סיפא
moves.summary: and reading it of protection contradicts its last clause

moves.cueHe: איבעית אימא בשומר, איבעית אימא ביד
moves.summary: answers that Rav may read it either way
moves.about: answering that Rav may read the baraita either of protection or of a handle, each time siding with one of its two tannaim

moves.cueHe: איבעית אימא ביד, והוא דאמר כרבי יהודה בן נקוסא
moves.summary: spells out each reading by aligning Rav with one or the other tanna of the baraita
moves.about: whether a handle attached to less than an olive-bulk of flesh conveys impurity — on the handle reading Rav sides with Yehuda ben Nekosa

moves.cueHe: ורבי יוחנן אמר: כולה ביד, והוא דאמר כתנא קמא
moves.summary: gives Rabbi Yoḥanan's reading: the whole baraita is about a handle, following the first tanna
moves.about: reading the whole bones baraita as dealing with a handle

moves.cueHe: תא שמע: רבי יהודה אומר, קולית שיש עליה כזית בשר
moves.summary: objects again from the femur baraita of Rabbi Yehuda and Aḥerim
moves.about: whether a handle or protection attached to less than an olive-bulk of flesh draws the whole bone into impurity

moves.cueHe: ורב האי במאי מוקים לה? אי ביד – קשיא סיפא
moves.summary: presses Rav on this baraita too: either reading breaks against one of its clauses
moves.about: how Rav can establish the femur baraita, since either reading contradicts one of its clauses

moves.cueHe: איבעית אימא ביד – והוא דאמר כרבי יהודה
moves.summary: answers by aligning Rav with Rabbi Yehuda on the handle reading and with Aḥerim on the protection reading
moves.about: whether a handle bearing less than an olive-bulk conveys impurity — on the handle reading Rav sides with Rabbi Yehuda

moves.cueHe: ורבי יוחנן אמר: כולה בשומר, והוא דאמר כאחרים
moves.summary: gives Rabbi Yoḥanan's reading: the whole baraita is about protection, following Aḥerim
moves.about: whether protection bearing less than an olive-bulk conveys impurity — Rabbi Yoḥanan reads the whole baraita of protection and sides with Aḥerim

moves.cueHe: אחרים, הא ״כפול״ קא אמרי!
moves.summary: objects that Aḥerim state a bean-bulk while Rabbi Yoḥanan requires no measure
moves.about: how Rabbi Yoḥanan can align with Aḥerim, who specify a bean-bulk, when he holds that even less suffices

moves.cueHe: איידי דקאמר תנא קמא שיעורא
moves.summary: answers that Aḥerim named a measure only in imitation of the first tanna
moves.about: answering that Aḥerim named a measure only because the first tanna had named one

moves.cueHe: אמר רבא: דיקא נמי דבשומר עסקינן, דקתני ״קולית״
moves.summary: Rava supports the protection reading from the baraita's word קולית, a bone with marrow
moves.about: inferring from the baraita's word קולית that it is dealing with protection and not with a handle

moves.cueHe: איתמר, רבי חנינא אמר: זהו שיעור
moves.summary: reports the dispute of Rabbi Ḥanina and Rabbi Yoḥanan over whether Aḥerim's bean-bulk is a fixed measure
moves.about: an unattributed report of the dispute whether Aḥerim's bean-bulk is a fixed measure

moves.cueHe: אין זה שיעור, והא קתני ״כפול״!
moves.summary: objects that the baraita states a bean-bulk outright
moves.about: how Rabbi Yoḥanan can deny that a measure was stated when the baraita explicitly teaches a bean-bulk

moves.cueHe: איידי דקאמר תנא קמא שיעורא
moves.summary: answers again that Aḥerim named a measure only in imitation
